title: AI Marketing Enablement Manager
descriptionHtml:
Does driving practical AI transformation for marketing teams get you excited?

Then Jobber might be the place for you! We’re looking for a AI Marketing Enablement Manager to join the Demand Generation team.

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers, while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers.

The Team

The Demand Generation team helps Jobber reach and engage small home service businesses through scalable marketing programs. We partner closely with Brand, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Sales, Data, and Product teams to create campaigns and experiences that drive awareness, pipeline, conversion, and customer growth.

This role will sit within Demand Generation and act as a force multiplier for the marketing organization. You’ll help marketers turn ideas into execution faster, reduce repetitive work, and develop new AI-enabled ways of planning, launching, analyzing, and optimizing campaigns.

The Role

This is a builder-and-coach role and also an ownership role. You’ll inherit an in-flight AI enablement program, which is a library of tools, agents, MCP integrations, prompts, evals, documentation, and a partially enabled team. You’ll become the internal owner who extends it, keeps it reliable, and drives adoption across Demand Generation and adjacent marketing teams.

You’ll partner with marketers across campaign strategy, lifecycle, paid acquisition, SEO, GEO/AEO, content, CRO, marketing operations, and analytics. You’ll create practical solutions yourself, then help marketers adopt, adapt, and eventually build on them independently. Because this field moves fast, part of the job is keeping our approach current as models, tools, and best practices evolve. You’re defining a capability, not maintaining a fixed toolset.

And the ambition goes beyond doing today’s work faster. We want AI to expand what our marketing team can do at all. You will be surfacing opportunities we can’t currently see and taking on work that simply isn’t practical by hand, like analyzing every creative we’ve run to learn what truly drives performance. Efficiency is the floor; new capability is the ceiling. A core part of this role is finding those frontier use cases and turning the ones that prove valuable into things the team can rely on.

The AI Marketing Enablement Manager will:

  • Own the handover and the foundation

    • Take ownership of the assets built during our external engagement: tools, agents, MCP servers, prompts, evals, and documentation, and make sure they remain reliable, understood, and extensible after the vendor rolls off.

    • Own and advance the AI maturity model already in motion, moving marketers from first useful wins to regular integration to self-sufficiency, and reporting progress to leadership.

    • Own the marketing AI roadmap: prioritize what to build next, decide what to sunset, and set the standards and patterns the team builds against.

  • Build

    • Build AI-powered tools, agents, automations, and skills tailored to real marketing workflows - e.g. campaign planning, audience research, content development, channel execution, reporting, experimentation, and optimization.

    • Build and maintain integrations that connect AI to live data - e.g., MCP servers linking ad platforms, analytics, and CRM. This is so marketers can work against real data in natural language instead of exporting and reconciling by hand.

    • Establish quality and reliability practices: evals, regression tests, and human-in-the-loop review so tools can be trusted against real campaigns and real data, and so they don’t silently break when models or platforms change.

  • Expand what’s possible

    • Use AI to uncover opportunities the team can’t currently see: patterns across campaigns, audiences, creative, channels, and content that would be impractical to surface by hand.

    • Take on analysis at a scale humans can’t - e.g. evaluating hundreds of creative variants, ad transcripts, landing pages, or search terms at once to extract what’s working and why, then feeding that back into strategy.

    • Prototype net-new capabilities, not just faster versions of existing work: doing things we couldn’t do before, testing whether they hold, and turning the ones that prove valuable into durable, repeatable tools.

  • Coach and scale

    • Embed with marketers to deeply understand their workflows, goals, deliverables, tools, and pain points, and identify the highest-leverage places AI creates real leverage.

    • Coach marketers through a practical adoption journey, from first win to regular use to building their own workflows

    • Recognize patterns across individual use cases and turn one-offs into reusable playbooks, templates, and tools, documented in version control so any marketer can read, run, and extend them.

    • Share wins and examples to build momentum, confidence, and excitement around AI-enabled marketing work.

    • Extend the model beyond Demand Gen into the broader marketing organization as the capability matures.

  • Operate responsibly

    • Partner with Data, Security, and IT to keep solutions scalable, reliable, and responsible with approved AI providers, sound data handling, appropriate human review, and clear accountability for AI outputs and actions.

    • Track impact with the number of workflows transformed, time saved (measured before/after), adoption, maturity progression, and library reuse

To be successful, you should have:

  • Hands-on experience using AI to materially improve marketing workflows or business processes, with experience on a working prototype on a real workflow

  • Experience building AI-powered tools, agents, automations, custom assistants, integrations, or agent workflows, and connecting them to real data sources.

  • Strong understanding of marketing work, ideally across demand generation, lifecycle, paid acquisition, SEO/GEO/AEO, content, marketing operations, analytics, or growth.

  • The ability to quickly learn how marketers work today and identify where AI creates meaningful leverage, and the judgment to know what should and shouldn’t be automated.

  • A frontier mindset with the curiosity to spot where AI can do something genuinely new, not just faster, and the drive to prototype it, test it, and prove whether it holds.

  • A quality mindset: comfort defining evals, testing outputs, and designing the human-in-the-loop checkpoints that make AI trustworthy in production.

  • Strong coaching and enablement skills, with the ability to teach technical concepts to non-technical audiences and adapt to different levels of AI fluency.

  • Strong systems thinking with turning one-off improvements into scalable, documented patterns.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity in a fast-moving field, and a habit of keeping current as models, tools, and best practices change.

  • Experience managing multiple stakeholders, workstreams, and priorities at once.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

It would be really great if you had:

  • Direct experience on a Demand Generation, Growth, Marketing Operations, Lifecycle, or Performance Marketing team.

  • Familiarity with modern marketing and data tooling such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Campaign Manager 360, GA4, Google Tag Manager, AppsFlyer, Firebase, Tableau, Looker, Metabase, Cube, Webflow, or Contentful.

  • Familiarity with current AI development and automation tooling - the specifics change quickly, but today that includes assistants and models (Claude, ChatGPT), agentic and dev tools (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, agent SDKs), the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for connecting agents to data and systems, orchestration and automation tools (LangGraph, n8n, Zapier, Make), eval/observability tooling, and version control (GitHub).

  • Experience building internal marketing tools, templates, workflows, or playbooks that were adopted by others.

  • Familiarity with campaign measurement, funnel analysis, experimentation, attribution, segmentation, or personalization.

  • Experience in change management, enablement, consulting, solutions engineering, or technical program management.

Location:

We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo.

Compensation:

At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $98,300 a midpoint of $115,700, and a maximum salary of $133,100, designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire’s skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual’s current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You’ll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we’re happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!

What you can expect from Jobber:

  • A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.

  • A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.

  • A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.

  • To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.

We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.

A bit more about us:

Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!
